name: Turkey

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27 after the ruling of the same day that counts transcontinental countries entire. Population on 1 January 2025: 85664944 inhabitants, recorded as 85.665 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, read through the dissemination API, the same table and the same call as every other country here. This figure had already been read earlier in the day and refused, the denominator then asking for Eastern Thrace alone; the ruling removed that requirement and the figure is now simply recorded. Note what the ruling does not change: the schools indicator still counts European establishments only, which is why Anadolu Üniversitesi in Eskişehir stays excluded from this country's count. The two indicators no longer share a scope. Here that costs nothing, Turkey's schools count being zero under either reading, but the mismatch is real and is documented in the schema.
Opening estimate, produced with no source and no research. It exists to be falsified, not to be used as data.

Recounted on 2026-07-28, after the scope ruling of the same day made countries countable entire. The value moves from 0 to 1 and no new school was found: what changed is that the school Turkey already had stopped being deleted by a line on a map. The puppet and shadow theatre branch of the state conservatoire of Anadolu University, Kukla ve Gölge Oyunu Sanat Dalı, sits in Eskişehir, in Anatolia, and the old scope counted European establishments only; the previous record said in as many words that this was the clearest case in the series of a rule removing a school that genuinely exists in a country. What was read today does not soften the case but does describe it exactly, so the record says how it stands. The branch page itself, read at source on 2026-07-27 and cited here, could not be re-read on 2026-07-28: the conservatoire site now serves a JavaScript shell to a plain fetch. The department's general page names two anasanat dalları, Tiyatro and Opera, and no third. The conservatoire's own admission guide for 2025-2026 admits students by programme, and the programmes are Tiyatro with nine general places, Opera with ten, and the music and instrument-making programmes; puppetry is nowhere in that table. So Kukla ve Gölge Oyunu is a named art branch inside the theatre degree and not a degree admitting its own intake — which is exactly the shape settled on 2026-07-27 as counting: Latvia's object theatre specialism inside an acting degree counts, Dantzerti's puppetry module inside one does not, and a sanat dalı is a specialism and not a module. Counted by establishment, as the whole layer is: the university counts once whatever it carries. Status disputed, on one point only — that the branch page could not be reopened today. The three performing-arts departments checked on 2026-07-27, Süleyman Demirel, Uludağ in Bursa and Dokuz Eylül, teach puppetry only as a technique inside scenography and are still not counted; Istanbul's universities were never checked one by one, which is what the upper bound of 2 now holds.

establishments.description: The puppet and shadow theatre branch of the state conservatoire of Anadolu University. A specialism inside the theatre degree, in the shape settled on 2026-07-27 as counting. Counted since the scope ruling of 2026-07-28, which stopped excluding it for sitting in Anatolia.
